target.title: fix(feishu): upgrade single newlines to paragraph breaks in post md messages
target.body: ## What Problem This Solves When OpenClaw sends messages to Feishu via `msg_type: post` with `tag: md`, single newline characters (`\n`) are rendered as plain spaces by the Feishu IM API. This causes multi-paragraph prose to appear visually cramped. Fixes #97074 ## Why This Change Was Made Added `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines()` — a dedicated function that upgrades single `\n` to `\n\n` outside code regions for Feishu post+md rendering. It runs only after the render mode is known, so card and document-comment text are never modified. **Revision 5** (per ClawSweeper re-review — single-pass normalization): 1. **[P2] Single-pass normalization for pre-chunked text** — Added `alreadyNormalized` flag to `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` and `sendMessageFeishu`. Callers that already normalized the full text before chunking (`sendOutboundText` overflow path, `reply-dispatcher` `sendChunkedTextReply`) pass `alreadyNormalized: true` so `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload` skips `normalizeFeishuPostMarkdownNewlines`. This prevents the second normalization pass from expanding code-block newlines when a chunk boundary falls inside a fenced region — the later chunk lacks the opening fence, so `findCodeRegions` would treat code newlines as prose. The edit path also passes `alreadyNormalized: true` since it normalizes before calling `buildFeishuPostMessagePayload`. 2. **[P2] Reply fanout for expanded subchunks** — Only the first subchunk carries the reply target (`replyToMessageId`, `replyInThread`). Later subchunks send without reply metadata so single-use implicit reply ids (`replyToMode: "first"`) are consumed once per platform send, matching core `sendTextMediaPayload` fanout behavior. **Revision 4** (ClawSweeper review — three findings addressed): 3. **[P1] Card routing on raw text** — `sendOutboundText` now routes `shouldUseCard(text)` on the original text before any normalization. Card text is never passed through the newline upgrader. 4. **[P2] Post-md rechunk after expansion** — After normalization, if expanded text exceeds 4000 chars, `sendOutboundText` rechunks it via `chunkTextForOutbound` and sends each chunk as a separate post message. 5. **[P2] Edit-path length guard** — `editMessageFeishu` now checks normalized length against the 4000-char limit before building the patch payload, throwing a clear error if exceeded. **Revision 3** (chunker scope fix): Moved normalization **out of** `feishuOutbound.chunker`. ## User Impact - Post-md messages render with visible paragraph breaks instead of cramped single-spaced text - Card-mode and document-comment text is never modified - Post-md sends rechunk after expansion, each payload stays inside Feishu's 4000-char limit - Reply fanout preserved: only the first expanded subchunk carries the reply target - Edit path rejects over-limit expanded content with a clear error - Single-pass normalization: pre-chunked subchunks are not re-normalized, so code-block content split across chunk boundaries is preserved unchanged ## Evidence - `pnpm test extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.test.ts` — 164/164 passed - `node_modules/.bin/oxlint --tsconfig config/tsconfig/oxlint.json --quiet extensions/feishu/src/send.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.ts extensions/feishu/src/reply-dispatcher.ts extensions/feishu/src/send.test.ts extensions/feishu/src/outbound.test.ts` — clean - `pnpm format:check` — All matched files use the correct format - `pnpm build` — exit 0 ### Real behavior proof Behavior addressed: card routing on raw text, post-md rechunk after expansion, edit-path length guard, reply fanout for subchunks, single-pass normalization for pre-chunked text. Real environment tested: Linux (Node 24.13.1), branch `fix/97074-feishu-post-md-newline`, commit `424b45798d`. Exact steps run: 1. Unit test suite (164 tests): includes new tests for `alreadyNormalized` flag and split-code-block regression 2. Previous revision: Gateway started — Feishu WebSocket connected, direct API comparison of single-`\n` vs double-`\n` post-md messages **Screenshots**: comparison of single-`\n` vs double-`\n` post-md messages in Feishu client What was not tested: bot reply via gateway (Feishu error 230101 blocked DM replies), older Feishu client versions, live rechunk path, live edit-path limit rejection.
